SSL::profile
Description
This command allows you to switch between SSL profiles (both client
and server).  Note:  If this is done after SSL negotiation, your iRule
must use
SSL::renegotiate
.
Switching an SSL profile requires that the virtual server have one
assigned to it to begin with.  This applies to both client- and
server-SSL profiles.  You can also use
SSL::disable
to use SSL selectively.
Warning
:  If you choose an SSL profile with a different
key/cert/chain/ca-file from the SSL profile configured under the VS,
the cert/key/ca-file must be reloaded, which is very time consuming
(about half a second), degrading the SSL TPS performance drastically.
Syntax
SSL
::
profile
<
profile_name
>
SSL::profile <profile_name>
Switch to the defined SSL profile.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
[
IP
::
addr
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
eq
$specific_ip
]}
{
SSL
::
profile
host1_profile
}
else
{
SSL
::
profile
ssl_profile2
}
}
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
SSL
::
renegotiate
}
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
if
{[
LB
::
server
port
]
==
443
}
{
SSL
::
profile
serverssl_profile
}
else
{
SSL
::
disable
}
}
